statement: The cover and lecture-plan annotation identify the topic and the written year 1976. The historical list is followed by the PD simplex, shadows, questions, arithmetic, integration and internal topos constructions. This is an editorial reconstruction of bundle order, not proof that every later sheet belonged to the delivered lecture.

statement: Archive scan identifiers, parenthesized lecture folios, lower-margin foliation, and donor typescript pages are separate numbering systems. Package A contains 44 retained scans (2–46 except 19); B contains 46 (48–78 and 80–94). Scan 93 has only foliation. These are supplied-file counts, not author-written totals.

his_words: acycliques sauf le dernier; tronquée en ... degré n; j≤i
statement: For S=Γ_k(T), the universal simplex algebra is C^{p,q}=Γ_k^p(Φ)⊗Λ_k^q(Ψ), with exterior degree q, total weight w=p+q and d:(p,q)→(p−1,q+1). Under exactness of each augmented weight strand and section-acyclicity of its terms q<w, its sections have H^q≅H^q(X,k)T^[w] for 0≤q≤w, and zero for q>w.
reconstruction: The clean w,q statement is a reconstruction of the intended comparison, not an emendation of p=0/H⁰ readings. Dimension shifting supplies the endpoint; the last term need not be acyclic.
check_reason: The notes correctly retain the second grading, exceptional last term and comparison range. The fixed-weight strand, rather than fixed complementary degree, is a complex.

his_words: Faisceautisation; si k est un Anneau comm. d’un topos; définir ... Rf_*
statement: Grothendieck proposes PD differential algebras internal to a ringed topos and structured derived direct images. Later sheets formulate test embeddings k→Φ with flat quotient and tensor-stable acyclicity, not a new site or a separate geometric object identified with the modern crystalline or de Rham topos.
reconstruction: The term “internalization” and the distinction between an algebraic construction and its derived direct image are modern restatements.
check_reason: Both the opening program and later concrete embedding data are present. The earlier run’s modern-site analogies have no textual identification behind them.

his_words: Notion des formes diff. (Poincaré ?); De Rham (conjecturé par E. Cartan)
statement: The historical plan questions the attribution of differential forms to Poincaré and recalls the de Rham theorem as conjectured by Élie Cartan; it also has a doubtful parenthetical question about the base of the arithmetic theory.
reconstruction: These are historical attributions and one unreadable scope question, not new mathematical conjectures.
check_reason: The question mark is explicit. A historical priority claim cannot be settled by normalizing the uncertain words.

his_words: simplement connexe (sauf erreur); une équivalence de cat.
statement: The recalled Sullivan result recovers rational homotopy from a nonnegative commutative differential graded Q-algebra with H⁰=Q and H¹=0. A precise standard equivalence requires the relevant rationalization and finite-type or appropriate duality hypotheses; these are not all written in the opening sentence.
reconstruction: Finite-type restrictions in the modern theorem are supplied explicitly as modern hypotheses, not attributed to this sentence. Reused English minimal-model text is a separate source layer.
check_reason: The note correctly identifies “sauf erreur” and does not backfill an editorial finiteness condition into the quote.

his_words: résolution de Q_*; objets acycliques; ce qui se vérifie facilement
statement: Polynomial rational forms on each affine simplex resolve Q by algebraic Poincaré, and their degreewise simplicial coefficient objects are asserted acyclic; both properties underlie comparison with ordinary rational cohomology. Smooth/analytic variants are additional asserted cases.
reconstruction: Acyclicity on each simplex is distinct from the acyclicity required after applying sections on a simplicial slice.
check_reason: The two assertions are separately written, but the second is compressed into “easily checked”; the notes do not promote that phrase to a supplied proof.

his_words: On aimerait avoir une Z-algèbre diff.; il paraît qu’il y a des ths contre !
statement: The hoped-for functorial integral anticommutative cochain algebra must be separated from the weighted PD construction actually made. Later obstruction theorems for natural unital commutative cochain theories have additional model-acyclicity and all-spaces comparison hypotheses; they do not refute the weighted finite-range result.
reconstruction: The identification with a specific later obstruction is a literature comparison, not an attribution in the manuscript.
check_reason: The warning and qualified ambition are explicit, and the later text preserves weights and leaves product obligations open.

his_words: on aurait envie de prendre; mais ce n’est plus; t∈J
statement: The naive PD affine simplex with ΣX_i=1 does not admit the proposed coordinate-elimination map into the standard integral PD polynomial algebra, because 1−Σ_{i<n}X_i is outside its PD ideal. Replacing 1 by a chosen t in a PD ideal J⊂S repairs that coordinate substitution.

check_reason: The two targets are explicitly different in the manuscript and are correctly separated in the entry.

his_words: Mais on ne peut dire en général quelle est sa cohomologie; elle ne sera pas isom.

statement: If the canonical weighted comparison is multiplicative, classes in weights r and s multiply as binom(r+s,r) times their ordinary cup product, in weight r+s. statement: The N-th shadow of a k-module M is ω_N(M)=⊕_{i≥N}M T^[i] over Γ_k(T), with the binomial action. The opening asserts recovery of M and pairings; scans20–34 later provide finite-tail proofs. No “tubulure” is defined in this range.
